sm_top.sm: The U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia announced travel restrictions following Houthi attacks targeting airports and oil facilities.
The U.S. withdrew heavy bombers from RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom following a security incident.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy ordered the resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries following US President Trump's assertions regarding an energy strike ceasefire.
An attack hit the presidential palace in Yemen's Aden, killing five people.
Seven crew members are missing following drone attacks on tankers near Romania's Black Sea coast.
Yemen's Houthis threatened further attacks on Saudi airports and oil infrastructure following a strike.
An oil tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz following an incident.
A missile or drone attack struck Terminal 4 of Riyadh's international airport, killing one person.
Ukraine resumed attacks on Russian oil refineries.
The USS Robert Smalls returns to San Diego following a 7-month deployment.
Saudi Arabia announced it successfully thwarted a missile strike targeting Medina.
President Zelenskyy states that allies failed to warn Ukraine of an impending missile attack.
Fighting intensified in Taiz between Yemeni government forces and Houthi fighters.
A suspected terrorism plot near RAF Fairford raises security concerns amid tensions related to Iran.
A ballistic missile struck the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran.
Reports indicate the United States is weighing the potential use of the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast in strike plans against Iran.
Malian forces supported by the Africa Corps regained control of Kidal following an extensive air operation.
Attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz reached record levels with vessels struck and sunk.
A ship caught fire in the Black Sea near Romania, prompting an investigation into a possible drone strike.
Ukrainian strikes targeted Russian data centers, posing significant challenges.
Russian drone debris damaged contemporary artwork at a museum in Lutsk.
Moscow was targeted by a massive drone attack, with air defense systems shooting down drones overnight as airports temporarily closed.
Ukrainian Armed Forces destroyed four bombers at a Russian airfield in Borisoglebsk.
Russian drone strikes left 370,000 residents without power in Volyn Oblast.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Russia launched attack drones and missiles.
Russian drone strikes in Ukraine killed three people and left 370,000 without power.
Germany agreed to provide tens of thousands of interceptor drones to Ukraine.
Russian strikes leave 600,000 residents in Ukraine without electricity.
Russian strikes in western Ukraine prompted Poland to scramble fighter jets.
Yemeni military forces reported carrying out airstrikes and neutralizing numerous Houthi fighters.
Missiles hit Kyiv as Ukraine accused the US of helping Russia.
Russian airstrikes on Kramatorsk caused deaths and injuries.
Moscow reported an overnight attack involving nearly 500 drones, leading to the suspension of operations at four airports.
Suspected Boko Haram fighters attacked a military base in Borno, leaving soldiers and civilians feared dead.
Ukraine is critically low or has exhausted its supply of U.S.-made Patriot interceptors as Russian strikes intensify.
Russian drone strikes in Kyiv injured people and caused damage.
Ethiopian forces advanced in Tigray and entered major cities including Aksum, Adigrat, and Adwa.
A Russian attack on Kirovohrad Oblast killed three people and injured six others.
Drone strikes set chemical tankers ablaze in Romanian Black Sea waters, leaving seven sailors missing.
Russian strikes in Ukraine caused casualties and injuries.
